spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (ऋ) गेषृ (गेषते)
To seek, to search, to investigate.

m. (-ष्णः)
1 A professional singer, an actor, a mime, &c.
2 A chaunter of the Sāma Veda.
E.
गै to sing, and इष्णच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-ष्णुः)
1 A singer.
2 An actor.
3 A chaunter of the Sāma Veda: see गेष्ण.
E.
गै to sing, and इष्णुच् Uṇādi aff.
